members.name: "_RETURN" on "$extension:postgis_raster".raster_columns
members.definition:
CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO "$extension:postgis_raster".raster_columns DO INSTEAD  SELECT current_database() AS r_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS r_table_schema,
    c.relname AS r_table_name,
    a.attname AS r_raster_column,
    COALESCE("$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_srid(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname), ( SELECT "$extension:postgis_raster".st_srid('010100000000000000000000000000000000000000'::"$extension:postgis".geometry) AS st_srid)) AS srid,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_scale(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname, 'x'::bpchar) AS scale_x,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_scale(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname, 'y'::bpchar) AS scale_y,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_blocksize(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname, 'width'::text) AS blocksize_x,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_blocksize(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname, 'height'::text) AS blocksize_y,
    COALESCE("$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_alignment(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname), false) AS same_alignment,
    COALESCE("$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_regular_blocking(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname), false) AS regular_blocking,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_num_bands(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname) AS num_bands,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_pixel_types(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname) AS pixel_types,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_nodata_values(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname) AS nodata_values,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_out_db(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname) AS out_db,
    "$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_extent(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname) AS extent,
    COALESCE("$extension:postgis_raster"._raster_constraint_info_index(n.nspname, c.relname, a.attname), false) AS spatial_index
   FROM pg_class c,
    pg_attribute a,
    pg_type t,
    pg_namespace n
  WHERE t.typname = 'raster'::name AND a.attisdropped = false AND a.atttypid = t.oid AND a.attrelid = c.oid AND c.relnamespace = n.oid AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text);

members.name: "_RETURN" on "$extension:postgis_raster".raster_overviews
members.definition:
CREATE RULE "_RETURN" AS
    ON SELECT TO "$extension:postgis_raster".raster_overviews DO INSTEAD  SELECT current_database() AS o_table_catalog,
    n.nspname AS o_table_schema,
    c.relname AS o_table_name,
    a.attname AS o_raster_column,
    current_database() AS r_table_catalog,
    split_part(split_part(s.consrc, '''::name'::text, 1), ''''::text, 2)::name AS r_table_schema,
    split_part(split_part(s.consrc, '''::name'::text, 2), ''''::text, 2)::name AS r_table_name,
    split_part(split_part(s.consrc, '''::name'::text, 3), ''''::text, 2)::name AS r_raster_column,
    TRIM(BOTH FROM split_part(s.consrc, ','::text, 2))::integer AS overview_factor
   FROM pg_class c,
    pg_attribute a,
    pg_type t,
    pg_namespace n,
    ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace,
            pg_constraint.conrelid,
            pg_constraint.conkey,
            pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc
           FROM pg_constraint) s
  WHERE t.typname = 'raster'::name AND a.attisdropped = false AND a.atttypid = t.oid AND a.attrelid = c.oid AND c.relnamespace = n.oid AND (c.relkind::text = ANY (ARRAY['r'::character(1), 'v'::character(1), 'm'::character(1), 'f'::character(1)]::text[])) AND s.connamespace = n.oid AND s.conrelid = c.oid AND s.consrc ~~ '%_overview_constraint(%'::text AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text);
